name: ghostb-training-area-sign
description: Design guide for Ghosts of Battle training-area ammo boards. Reproduce exactly to match fa_sign_*.png in /art. Reference blank: 'art/ghostb Training Area.png'.

canvas.format_engine: PAA DXT1 via `hemtt utils paa convert <png> <paa>`

palette.note: ember/amber/slate mirror the in-game diary colours; do not substitute

wood_grain.type: vertical strokes over the face, under the text
wood_grain.note: keep alpha <= 14; the grain must be barely visible

badge.asset: addons/main/data/logo_256.paa (colored skeleton) — convert to PNG, keep alpha
badge.rule: always present, never scaled above 256 source size

title.autofit: shrink in steps of 4 down to min 56 until width <= width - 96(left) - 96(right) - 252(badge) - 48(gap); vertically recentre by (96 - size)/2

row_step.few_rows: if block is short, centre it: y += (1024 - 190 - rows_start_y - step*rows)/2

two_column.use_when: more than ~9 rows or two weapon systems

tracer_dots.use_when: the calibre's loads come in tracer colours; omit for 40mm/rockets
tracer_dots.position: footer right: first dot centre x = 2048 - 96 - 6*46 - 16, y = 928

content_conventions.title: <CALIBRE or SYSTEM> — <WEAPONS>, em-dash separated, UPPERCASE
content_conventions.rows: designation in amber exactly as the arsenal shows it (Mk327 HV, XM891 CTEP, AF-556C CT, Type 42 CT, DBP-39 CT); description starts with an em-dash, lowercase, <= ~55 chars, optional (year) or range at the end
content_conventions.row_order: ball/standard first, then CT, then AP, then specialty (PAB last for rifles); rockets: AT first, then HE/utility, then C-UAS, then AA
content_conventions.footer: one practical usage line, dot-separated; mention the [Ghost] arsenal tag on rifle-calibre boards
content_conventions.designation_sides: NATO = Mk/XM/M · Russian = GRAU 7N/7U · CSAT = Type ## / DBP · AAF = AF-##

output_checklist: convert: hemtt utils paa convert art/fa_sign_<topic>.png addons/main/data/fa_sign_<topic>.paa (delete stale paa first; converter refuses to overwrite)
verify DXT1 and 2048x1024 with: hemtt utils paa inspect
